title: Offline Independent Human Review Intake and Evidence Integrity
scientific_question: Can coordinator securely intake original condition-masked 9-clip CSV submissions from three distinct consenting external humans without creating synthetic data, leaking treatment keys or changing V3-60 criteria/estimands?
acceptance: Every original CSV has exactly V3-60 schema, 9 complete rows, 9 distinct frozen masked clip IDs and one non-test-only reviewer pseudonym.
Exactly 3 separate CSV files are required for the initial three-person counterbalanced panel; assign one unique V3-61 form order each.
Reject changed order, missing clips, duplicate IDs, forged/TEST_ONLY reviewer names, low-score without timestamp, non-ordinal scores and dangerous/unknown metadata.
Require a coordinator-signed-in-process pseudonymous consent/eligibility/conflict/independence checklist per rater, retaining actual evidence privately; booleans are not independent proof.
Reject partial intake and reject pre-existing output path. Never access admin assignment key or accept it among submitted files.

Combine scores and invoke the UNMODIFIED V3-60 seal in a single local offline step before the coordinator can manually unblind. Emit only local private raw CSV and lock JSON, never uploaded to GitHub Actions.
All mocks and fake scores are explicitly TEST_ONLY and cannot pass production-facing intake. No fabricated independent rating, no automatic product GO.
Dedicated no-secret/no-network CI tests positive and hostile negative paths, including incomplete/no inputs.
Preserve V3-60/61 preregistered estimands, existing 9 MP4 SHA-256, untouched V2 Core and production prompts.

limitations.study_confounds: Static condition also has early answer reveal; this is not a pure motion-only comparison

stop_conditions: No original independent human reviews or consent evidence
